0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The vengeful Nu Mou is bent on revenge.

24.original: Deliver the mock ancient texts to the pixies.

25.original: Report to the vengeful Nu Mou.

48.original: Grrr, those accursed pixies! I never should've trusted them!

49.original: I asked them for sheep's milk. They demanded their payment first, and against my better judgment, I gave it to them. I've not seen neither hide nor hair of them since!

50.original: But they will rue the day they cheated this Nu Mou! I'll get my revenge─with your help, mortal!

51.original: Your task is simple. Take these mock ancient texts I've prepared and give them to the pixies. The rest should play out by itself, and I will have my revenge─and you your fitting payment!

52.original: And if the pixies think to ask where the texts come from, just say that you found it at the Church at Dammroen Field.

53.original: Please find the cheating pixies and give them the mock ancient texts. The rest should play out by itself, and I will have my revenge─and you your fitting payment!

54.original: Hm? You wish to give me something, you say?

55.original: Ooh, it says here there's a secret flower garden! And the way will be revealed if one makes an offering of sheep's milk to the leafman north of here!

56.original: Tee hee, I must go and tell everyone...right after I've had my fill of the garden!

57.original: Well now, what's a mortal doing here?

58.original: This was at the church? Let's see, now... <gasp> It tells you the way to get to a secret garden!

59.original: All you need is sheep's milk, and it just so happens we have the extra we didn't give the Nu Mou! I'll go and test it out at once!

60.original: You gave the pixies the texts, and they believed it? Hah hah hah! Such sweet revenge!

61.original: Here, mortal─the fitting payment for your excellent service! Now, if you'll excuse me, I have sheep's milk to collect!
